findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_image · Private data: analyze_image, compress_image, optimize_for_vision · Public sink: optimize_for_vision · Destructive: get_format_info, analyze_image, compress_image, convert_image, image_pipeline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_image · Private data: analyze_image, compress_image, optimize_for_vision · Public sink: optimize_for_vision · Destructive: get_format_info, analyze_image, compress_image, convert_image, image_pipeline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
